name: Airbnb Stays
author: John Jahn
description: Search Airbnb for your dates without leaving your trip. Compare prices and ratings, then add the winner to the plan in one tap.

settings.label: This TREK server's URL
settings.hint: The address your users reach TREK on, including any path it is hosted under. Save it before pressing "Register with OpenBnB", which sits on your own Settings → Plugins → Airbnb Stays card rather than in this form.

settings.label: OAuth authorize URL
settings.hint: Constant for the hosted OpenBnB service. Type the greyed-out value exactly as shown, and change it only if you run your own OpenBnB.

settings.label: OAuth token URL
settings.hint: Constant for the hosted OpenBnB service. Type the greyed-out value exactly as shown, and change it only if you run your own OpenBnB.

settings.label: OAuth client id
settings.hint: Press "Register with OpenBnB" on your own Settings → Plugins → Airbnb Stays card, then paste the client id it prints. Unique to this TREK instance. (Scripted alternative: npm run register -- <your TREK URL>.)

settings.label: OAuth client secret
settings.hint: From the same registration. Stored encrypted, and never leaves this server.

settings.label: OpenBnB MCP endpoint
settings.hint: Optional. Leave blank to use the hosted OpenBnB service, which is the value shown greyed out.

settings.label: Map style

options.label: Esri grey canvas (default, matches TREK's basemap)
Custom tile server (fill in the three fields below)

settings.hint: Which basemap the "Where you'll be" map draws on. Leave unset for Esri's grey canvas, which needs no key and matches TREK's own maps.

settings.label: Custom map tiles
settings.hint: Only read when Map style is Custom. Add the host under Allowed hosts too, or the tiles will not load.

settings.label: Custom map tiles (dark theme)
settings.hint: Only read when Map style is Custom. Leave blank to reuse the light tiles above on a dark theme.

settings.label: Custom map attribution
settings.hint: Leave blank and the credit follows whichever tile source is in use. Set it when you point the tiles at a provider the plugin does not recognise, since publishing the wrong credit is a licensing problem rather than a cosmetic one.

actions.label: Register with OpenBnB
actions.hint: Registers this server with OpenBnB and prints a client id and secret. Fill in "This TREK server's URL" under Admin → Plugins → Airbnb Stays → Instance settings and Save first, then paste the two values back into that form.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks this instance's OpenBnB settings end to end and names the first thing that is wrong.
